t: The Deta TTE male flexible conduit adaptor in white securely terminates 20mm round flexible conduit runs into electrical boxes and enclosures. This pack of 5 x PVC fittings is ideal for trade professionals and electricians routing cables through demanding commercial and domestic environments. A robust compression design provides reliable conduit retention and integrated cable strain relief, whilst creating a seal that fully protects connections against dust and water ingress. These durable adaptors ensure a neat, safe and highly secure termination for both indoor and outdoor cable management installations.
